name: youtube-trend-finder
description: Collect YouTube trend evidence and create proposals for a required editorial profile.

interface.longDescription: Require one editorial profile, collect broad YouTube evidence, score trend strength separately from profile fit, and guide an agent to produce original, profile-adapted proposals.
defaultPrompt: Find profile-fit YouTube video proposals for a niche
Rank current trends for an editorial profile
Collect US YouTube evidence with --profile possumdotmov
